usage_note: Same method kept (height map on sphere, one shader); it can give the requested features. Renders are software previews, not GPU renders. Old v1 files untouched.
open_questions: Run the shaders on a real GPU window (render.gd points at v1; edit paths) to check silhouette, halo and frame_time_ms.
Halo costs a second draw call per planet; accept, or drop it on small map sizes?
Import height_*_v2.png as Lossless with mipmaps off in the editor (VRAM compression blurs the steps).
handoff: Not wired. Prototype v2: art/planets/planet_v2.tscn (sphere 128x64 16,640 tris plus halo shell 960 tris, 2 draw calls). Materials planet_<type>_v2.tres and halo_<type>_v2.tres, types volcanic, temperate, barren; swap both materials by planet type key. Height maps 384x192, 16 to 25 KB. Shaders planet_v2.gdshader and halo_v2.gdshader (halo uses cull_front and blend_add). Renders 512 px: art/planets/renders/planet_<type>_v2.png. Frame time and GPU compile not measured.
